title: BPCL Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 154 Technician & Operator Posts
description: The Bharat Petroleum Corporation (BPCL) has officially released the notification to fill 154 Process Technician, Process Operator, and Technician posts. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering can apply for the BPCL Notification 2026. Interested applicants can apply in online mode.
